body.message:
Good Morning,

As per your request, please find below the 3-month rates for the 2-bedroom apartment at Aykon City Tower C, Business Bay:

October: AED 16,000
November: AED 21,000
December: AED 22,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-aykon-city-aykon-city-tower-c-16180579.html

*
Please also note that the rate displayed online is applicable only for September. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. The above rates are the applicable rates for your requested dates.
*

To secure the booking for the full requested period, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit will need to be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we can reserve the apartment and secure the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you with the next steps.

Thank you, and we look forward to assisting you.
